summary: Validated the new 3-step Facility wizard end-to-end on the live preview URL against an empty DB (0 facilities). All step gating, progress indicator states (active/done), pre-fills, Back-preserves-values, formula-preview live update, POST /api/facilities persistence, and downstream reflection on Dashboard + CC Interest Working all work correctly. Fresh-state reopen after abandoning mid-flow also verified. DB left empty (test facility deleted). Empty states on Dashboard and Facility Master render cleanly.

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by dev-time instrumentation wrapping text nodes with <span style=display:contents> inside <option>. Not user-visible but pollutes the console.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Investigate the hydration warning on CC Interest Working page — likely tied to the dev-instrumentation (x-ve-dynamic spans) inside <option> children; only visible in console, doesn't affect functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: FacilityForm wizard (Facilities.jsx) is clean, single component ~130 lines — OK size. Step state resets naturally because <FacilityForm> is unmounted on close (showForm=false), which is why the fresh-reopen test passes; good pattern.
Step-2 Maturity pre-fill is set only when Type is changed on step 1; if a user changes Type after going forward and coming back, maturity is overwritten (acceptable UX, but worth noting).
Rate min='0.01' on step 3 enforces > 0; consistent with valid[3] check. Good.
No trim on facility name/bank before POST — leading/trailing whitespace would persist. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created one facility (Kotak Mahindra Bank / Cash Credit / CC / limit 2Cr / rate 9.25% / Actual-365) to test the wizard end-to-end; deleted via DELETE /api/facilities/{id} after testing. DB is back to 0 facilities as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 3-step facility wizard is fully functional. DB is intentionally empty (app_meta.seed_disabled flag is set). Old pytest test files that hardcode icici-cc/hdfc-cc/axis-wcdl/sbi-wcdl IDs will still fail — separate backlog item, don't touch. When testing anything that requires facilities, CREATE them via the wizard/POST and DELETE when done.
